verdict.rationale: SvelteKit is Svelte's official full-stack meta-framework. First-party docs say it is the counterpart to Next/Nuxt and supports SSG, SPA and other rendering modes, and the official CLI scaffolds SvelteKit projects. Community users confirm folder-based routing and clear server/client load ordering with form actions. Missing for 10: first-party documentation excerpts on the routing and data-loading APIs themselves (that evidence is community-only), and resolution of a community report that it lags Next.js in polish.
